name: layout-swap
description: One ripples effect re-nested across three layout kinds: Grid → Ring → Wheel. Exercises re-pointing the structural parent across distinct LayoutModule types — only authorable because ADR 0007 made the effect's generic `layout` input match by category (Ring/Wheel register as types ring-layout/wheel-layout but category()==layout). Each reparent triggers onUpdate(layout) → geometry re-resolve at the new layout's extent (mirrors v1 xmas-tree-3d intent: swap the layout, measure the projection cost).
